features.title: 4 Interactive CCTV Feeds
features.body: The official page names Hallway, Storage, Office, and Generator rooms as the four active feeds.

features.title: Dynamic Anomaly System
features.body: Random entity spawns and volatile signal feedback are the main threat loop.

features.title: Real-time Corruption Meter
features.body: Purge anomalies quickly enough to avoid total system blackout.

features.title: Survival Chronometer
features.body: The game tracks survival time, making clean camera rotation more important than panic clicking.

cameras.name: CAM 01 - Hallway
cameras.checkRule: Scan first in each loop because hallway changes are easy to miss when you tunnel on one room.

cameras.name: CAM 02 - Storage
cameras.checkRule: Look for shape displacement, unusual silhouettes, and signal distortion around shelves or corners.

cameras.name: CAM 03 - Office
cameras.checkRule: Use this feed as a reset point after purging, then return to a full camera cycle.

cameras.name: CAM 04 - Generator
cameras.checkRule: Treat generator anomalies as high priority because the game frames blackout as the fail state.

controls.action: Isolate and clear anomalies on the currently active feed.

qualityRules: This site does not copy the itch.io page into many thin pages.
Pages are limited to player intent: play, guide, cameras, anomalies, survival, and sources.
Unknown anomaly names, exact spawn rates, and hidden formulas are not invented.
The monitor planner is original utility content, not filler text.
